description: Claude Code against the local Qwen3.6 model. Same settings as the claude-local alias in ~/.zshrc.
startHint: Start the model and the proxy first: start-qwen.sh and start-proxy.sh.
restartHint: The proxy is running but the model server behind it is not working. Stop start-qwen.sh (Ctrl+C in its terminal, or kill the mlx_lm.server process), start it again, and check its terminal for the error that killed it.
